title: Strict henselization preserves local Krull dimension
statement: Let $R$ be a local commutative ring and $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure of its residue field. Then $\dim R=\dim R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].
